name: 70420 · Abita Springs, LA
findings: ZIP 70420 (Abita Springs) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70420 (Abita Springs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
